Clause 9.9.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect and preserve the identifie d period buildings within the precinct and 
encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.9.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect the identified Heritage Items  within the precinct.

Clause 9.9.2 - height_limit (development_control): To maintain distinctly single storey streetscapes that exist within the precinct.

Clause 9.9.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect groups or runs of buildings which retain their original built form 
including roof forms, o riginal detailing and finishes.

Clause 9.9.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect  significant streetscape s and/or public domain elements within the 
precinct including landscaping, fencing, open space, sandsto ne kerbing and 
guttering, views and vistas and prevailing subdivision patterns.

Clause 9.9.2 - zoning (development_control): To preserve the predominantly low density residen tial character of the precinct.

Clause 9.9.2 - parking (development_control): To ensure that the provision and location of off -street car parking does not 
adversely impact the amenity of the precinct.

Clause 9.9.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect the identified values of the Petersham South ( Norwood Estate ) 
Heritage Conservation Area, N orwood Park Es tate Heritage Conservation Area 
and the  Llewellyn Estate Heritage Conservation Area.
